title: Optimizer: select_related preserved from the queryset is dropped from only() by a prefix match without `__` boundary
author: cordeiror
body_preview: ## Summary  `OptimizerStore._apply_select_related` tries to keep manually-applied `select_related` in the `only()` mask, but the coverage check is a raw string prefix match. When two relations on the same model share a name prefix (`empresa` / `empresa_comercial`), selecting only the longer one makes the optimizer believe the shorter one is covered.
